The named pair transmits differing versions of Amemar, and Ashi objects directly to Amemar in the same discussion. This confirms the setting while leaving Heilprin’s inference of physical presence qualified.
The earlier-pair discussion distinguishes Rav Acha bar Rav and the early Ravina and preserves name variants. It does not govern all bare-name cases.
